solution:
Since $1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} + \omega^{3k}$ with common ratio $\omega^k \neq 1,$ we can write
\[\frac{1}{1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} + \omega^{3k}} = \frac{1 - \omega^k}{1 - \omega^{4k}}.\]Since $\omega^{1729} = e^{2 \pi i} = 1,$
\[\omega^k = \omega^k \cdot (\omega^{1729})^3k = \omega^{5188k},\]so
\begin{align*}
\frac{1 - \omega^k}{1 - \omega^{4k}} &= \frac{1 - \omega^{5188k}}{1 - \omega^{4k}} \\
&= 1 + \omega^{4k} + \omega^{8k} + \dots + \omega^{5184k} \\
&= \sum_{j = 0}^{1296} \omega^{4jk}.
\end{align*}Therefore,
\begin{align*}
\sum_{k = 1}^{1728} \frac{1}{1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} + \omega^{3k}} &= \sum_{k = 1}^{1728} \sum_{j = 0}^{1296} \omega^{4jk} \\
&= \sum_{j = 0}^{1296} \sum_{k = 1}^{1728} \omega^{4jk} \\
&= 1728 + \sum_{j = 1}^{1296} \sum_{k = 1}^{1728} \omega^{4jk} \\
&= 1728 + \sum_{j = 1}^{1296} (\omega^{4j} + \omega^{8j} + \dots + \omega^{4 \cdot 1728j}) \\
&= 1728 + \sum_{j = 1}^{1296} \omega^{4j} (1 + \omega^{4j} + \dots + \omega^{4 \cdot 1727j}) \\
&= 1728 + \sum_{j = 1}^{1296} \omega^{4j} \cdot \frac{1 - \omega^{4 \cdot 1728j}}{1 - \omega^{4j}} \\
&= 1728 + \sum_{j = 1}^{1296} \frac{\omega^{4j} - \omega^{4 \cdot 1729j}}{1 - \omega^{4j}} \\
&= 1728 + \sum_{j = 1}^{1296} \frac{\omega^{4j} - 1}{1 - \omega^{4j}} \\
&= 1728 + \sum_{j = 1}^{1296} (-1) \\
&= 1728 - 1296 = \boxed{432}.
\end{align*}

\[\frac{1}{1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} + \omega^{3k}} = \frac{\omega^k - 1}{\omega^{4k} - 1}.\]Since $\omega^{1729} = 1,$ $\omega^{4k} - 1 = \omega^{4k} - \omega^{5188} = \omega^{4k} (1 - \omega^{5144k}).$  Also, $\omega^{5144k} = (\omega^{1729 \cdot 3 - 12k})^3 = (\omega^{-12k})^3 = \omega^{-36k}.$  Hence,
\[\frac{\omega^k - 1}{\omega^{4k} - 1} = \frac{\omega^k - 1}{\omega^{4k} (1 - \omega^{-36k})} = \frac{\omega^{37k} - \omega^{36k}}{\omega^{40k} - 1}.\]Again, $\omega^{40k} - 1 = \omega^{40k} - \omega^{5200k} = \omega^{40k} (1 - \omega^{5160k}),$ and $\omega^{5160k} = (\omega^{1729 \cdot 3 - 4k})^3 = (\omega^{-4k})^3 = \omega^{-12k}.$  Hence,
\[\frac{\omega^{37k} - \omega^{36k}}{\omega^{40k} - 1} = \frac{\omega^{37k} - \omega^{36k}}{\omega^{40k} (1 - \omega^{-12k})} = \frac{\omega^{50k} - \omega^{49k}}{\omega^{52k} - 1}.\]Then
\[\frac{1}{1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} + \omega^{3k}} = \frac{\omega^{50k} - \omega^{49k}}{(\omega^{52k} - 1)(\omega^k - 1)} = \frac{\omega^{50k}}{\omega^{52k} - 1} - \frac{\omega^{49k}}{\omega^k - 1}.\]Thus, the given sum telescopes:
\begin{align*}
\sum_{k = 1}^{1728} \frac{1}{1 + \omega^k + \omega^{2k} + \omega^{3k}} &= \left( \frac{\omega^{50}}{\omega^{52} - 1} - \frac{\omega^{49}}{\omega - 1} \right) + \left( \frac{\omega^{100}}{\omega^{104} - 1} - \frac{\omega^{98}}{\omega^2 - 1} \right) + \dots + \left( \frac{\omega^{86400}}{\omega^{86404} - 1} - \frac{\omega^{86398}}{\omega^{1728} - 1} \right) \\
&= \frac{\omega^{50}}{\omega^{52} - 1} + \frac{\omega^{100}}{\omega^{104} - 1} + \dots + \frac{\omega^{86400}}{\omega^{86404} - 1} \\
&\quad - \frac{\omega^{49}}{\omega - 1} - \frac{\omega^{98}}{\omega^2 - 1} - \dots - \frac{\omega^{86398}}{\omega^{1728} - 1}.
\end{align*}Since $\omega^{1729} = 1,$
\begin{align*}
\frac{\omega^{50}}{\omega^{52} - 1} + \frac{\omega^{100}}{\omega^{104} - 1} + \dots + \frac{\omega^{86400}}{\omega^{86404} - 1} &= \frac{\omega^{50}}{\omega^{52} - 1} + \frac{\omega^{100}}{\omega^{104} - 1} + \dots + \frac{\omega^{86450}}{\omega^{86454} - 1} \\
&= \frac{\omega^{49}}{\omega - 1} + \frac{\omega^{98}}{\omega^2 - 1} + \dots + \frac{\omega^{86398}}{\omega^{1728} - 1}.
\end{align*}Therefore, the sum is $\boxed{0}.$
